अ॑लम् ind. (later form of अ॑रम्, q.v.), enough, sufficient, adequate, equal to, competent, able. (अलम् may govern a dat. [जी॑वितवै॑ (Ved. Inf. dat.) अ॑लम्, AV. vi, 109, 1, or अलं जीवनाय, Mn. xi, 76, &c., sufficient for living] or Inf. [Pāṇ. ii, 4, 66; अलं विज्ञातुम् ‘able to conceive’, Nir. ii, 3] or instr. [Pāṇ. ii, 3, 27; Siddh.; अलं शङ्कया, enough i.e. away with fear!] or gen. [अलं प्रजायाः, capable of obtaining progeny, PBr.] or may be used with the fut. [अलं हनिष्यति, he will be able to kill, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 154, Sch.] or with an ind. [Pāṇ. iii, 4, 18; अलं भुक्त्वा, enough of eating i.e. do not eat more, अलं विचार्य, enough of consideration].)
